'''Boga noga''' was an extremely strong [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Ale/Legends|ale]]. It was so [[Alcohol/Legends|intoxicating]] that two containers could knock out an entire squadron of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and it was often joked that it made a good [[Engine/Legends|engine]] flush. [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] claimed to actually have used it this way.
